rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
Supports Dual Channel DDR4 1866/2133/2400/2667/2933(OC)/3200(OC)
 
4 x DDR4 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 64 GB Memory
 
Each DIMM supports non-ECC 8/16 GB DDR4 module
 
* DDR4 - 2667 only for Ryzen CPU.
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.value:

1x M.2 (M Key) : Supports PCI-E 3.0 x4 (32Gb/s) & SATA III (6.0Gb/s) SSD
 
* M.2 : The bandwidth is depended on CPU.
